title: Float style — session menu, second pass

steps.path: Header — the arrow at the end of the session switcher, list scrolled a little
steps.headline: The session list's rows now fade out cleanly at the top and bottom, and the menu is a little less see-through.
steps.changed: The list used to fade under a band painted in the theme's panel colour, which showed as a dark stripe on the see-through menu. Now the rows themselves fade to clear, like messages under the bottom controls. The menu's fill went from 16% to 24%.
steps.notice: Midnight (no wallpaper) keeps a solid menu: with nothing to blur, the chat behind showed through the rows sharply. The list is scrolled a little in every picture so both fades show.
steps.risk: Over busy wallpaper, blurred chat bubbles still show faintly through the menu.
